title: Standard Endpoint Order Cancellation Fee After the Purchase Order
content:
**Fee clause.** The fee charged when a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order is cancelled after its purchase order was placed and before it shipped is the order type's after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage of the order's quote total. For a Standard Endpoint Order that percentage is the figure shown for it in the order type's cancellation terms, 10 percent.

**Build.** The percentage is applied to the order's quote total, and the fee so built is the fee charged.

**Rounding.** The endpoint cancellation fee is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount; no intermediate figure is rounded.

**Inputs and where they are read**

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Quote total | the cancelled order's own quote total |
| Fee percentage | the Standard Endpoint Order's after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage |

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Hypothetical quote total | Percentage | Unrounded fee | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6400.00 | 10 | 640.00 | 640.00 |
| 7777.75 | 10 | 777.775 | 777.78 |

In the second line the unrounded amount of 777.775 is rounded half up once, to 777.78.
